whyNoBoundVerifiedExists: No component in this deployment writes a durable, canonical binding from a Work AttemptId to a DSH SessionId. `BOUND_VERIFIED` is therefore unreachable in V0 for a real product attempt, and V0 never assigns it.

identityOwners.producedBy: the Work owner — `stableEntityId('attempt', actionKey('attempt-create-v1', {...}))` at src/scheduler/scheduler.ts:493
identityOwners.cardinality: one per prepared attempt; the address V0 uses

identityOwners.durability: DSH-owned; durable in the session log
identityOwners.cardinality: NOT assumed to be 1:1 with an attempt

identityOwners.durability: derived read-model address; NOT an authority

cardinalityNotAssumed: V0 keeps the four execution identities as four separate fields and never derives one from another. The tests assert that a caller-supplied SessionId can reach at most BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY, and that a conflicting header is CONFLICT.

measuredOutcomes.scenario: a real non-model Work Attempt, no session claimed
measuredOutcomes.note: a real host observation supports the binding, but no canonical producer confirms it, so it may not claim BOUND_VERIFIED

measuredOutcomes.scenario: a real attempt with a caller-supplied session id and NO reader composed
measuredOutcomes.note: the session is IDENTIFIED but the read capability is absent — reported as SESSION_IDENTIFIED_NOT_READ, never as an empty history

measuredOutcomes.scenario: a real attempt with a caller-supplied id whose header names a DIFFERENT session
measuredOutcomes.note: a contradiction is never downgraded to unbound

measuredOutcomes.scenario: a caller-supplied id accepted by a real reader (header agrees)
measuredOutcomes.note: a declaration is evidence of a REQUEST, not of a binding — this is the ceiling for a caller-supplied id

cwdScopeCheckIsNotOwnership.limitation: A DSH Session's cwd matching a Work World would support a SCOPE check, but scope alone does not establish exclusive Attempt ownership — so it can never raise a binding above BOUND_LOCAL_ONLY.
cwdScopeCheckIsNotOwnership.measuredAbsence: A scan of all 1142 persisted session headers found 462 whose cwd contains `palimpsest`, and ZERO whose cwd is a `.palimpsest/worlds/<attemptId>` execution world.

missingProducerRequirement.requirement: A durable Attempt→DSH Session binding producer
missingProducerRequirement.producerThatWouldOwnIt: the host/deployment boundary (the worker port already knows the child it spawned and the attempt it was prepared for)
missingProducerRequirement.authority: host-local lifecycle metadata, NOT a canonical Work fact and NOT a new owner
missingProducerRequirement.lifecycle: written when the port spawns the child; readable after the child exits; may be lost on host restart
missingProducerRequirement.failureSemantics: a missing binding must degrade to SESSION_UNBOUND, never to a guess
missingProducerRequirement.reason: §11 forbids creating the store prematurely; V0 records the requirement instead
